verdict.name: Ask about an authorised client record

route_mapping.name: clients.rag.ask
route_mapping.actor_surface: compatibility endpoint for any, assigned or self-authorised access

route_mapping.name: operations.clients.rag.ask
route_mapping.frontend_activation: none_found_in_current_frontend; static authorization test uses it

route_mapping.name: rag.clients
route_mapping.actor_surface: authorised client picker supporting the global staff query dialog

page_mapping.shared_host_note: PAGE-0713 hosts the client-self widget but is primarily owned by CLI-PORTAL-CLIENT.
page_mapping.global_surface: GlobalQueryBar is embedded in shared AppHeader and AppSidebarHeader and has no exclusive resolver page.

identity_lenses.user_job: An authorised person selects or arrives at an authorised Client, asks a question about that record, and receives an answer with sources.
identity_lenses.actors: Staff any-client, staff assigned-client and client-self are permission scopes of the same job; next-of-kin is expressly excluded from the unredacted store.
identity_lenses.aggregate: All five routes operate on Client and its per-client openai_vector_store_id.
identity_lenses.state: Client selected or bound, question validated, provider enabled or disabled, vector store absent or available, snapshot built and attached, answer or error returned.
identity_lenses.completion: The same file-search answer and sources are returned. Redirect/flash versus JSON/dialog transport does not change the user outcome.
identity_lenses.side_effects: Both controllers create the same per-client vector store when absent, build the same rolling snapshot, write/upload it and attach it to the same store.
identity_lenses.handoff: Neither implementation defines a distinct persisted workflow handoff or downstream owner.

identity_reasoning: The portal widget omits selection because the Client is already bound; the global dialog adds a picker because staff may access multiple authorised clients.
Both controllers use the same ClientRagIndexer, OpenAiVectorStoreClient, model, system instruction, vector store and answer/source contract.
Role and direct-object checks change eligible records, not the aggregate, state machine or completion outcome.
ROUTE-0189 is explicitly compatibility-only and no current frontend consumer was found for ROUTE-2040.

denominator_effect.operation: Collapse two working RAG H rows into CLI-CLIENT-RAG and enrich it with the previously excluded PLAT-RAG route family.

benchmark_boundary.reason: The final target merges two prior adjudication units; target-specific benchmark/NCM research must be rerun.

proof_caveats: No representative-role runtime or browser journey was executed.
Static tests were inspected but not run.
No current frontend caller was found for ROUTE-0189 or ROUTE-2040; direct-request reachability remains.
Answer persistence, audit history, remote vector-store lifecycle and degraded-provider behaviour remain runtime-unverified.
